notes.title: Thank You For Playing The Demo!
notes.content:
[h3][b]Thanks to everyone who tried the Marble Dash Demo and got some scores on the leaderboards! 

Hope you enjoyed the demo![/b] 

As the prep for the full launch is on route, another demo will be available on full release. Many changes have been made from that original demo launch, due to all the great feedback. 

[b]Hope to see you all at the full release![/b][/h3]
